name: ESO 306-17 (Hubble)
blurb: ESO 306-17, a giant elliptical galaxy at the heart of a fossil group, seen by Hubble.
label: eso306g017-hubble
story: ESO 306-17 lies almost abandoned in an enormous sea of dark matter and hot gas, the lone giant of a fossil group. Astronomers wonder whether it gobbled up its former neighbors.

claims.text: ESO 306-17 is a large, bright elliptical galaxy of the type known as a fossil group
It lies in an enormous sea of dark matter and hot gas
Fossil groups' light is dominated by a single, isolated, large elliptical galaxy
Astronomers ask whether it consumed its neighbors
ESO306-017 is a fossil group galaxy
